## Description

The Vago permanent plot lies in the Vago Forest Reserve, a protected area established in 1959 north of Suva, on the island of Viti Levu. The plot was set up in July 2026 on a gentle slope at about 220 m elevation. The forest shows no obvious signs of recent disturbance.

The most abundant species include *Haplolobus floribundus* (Burseraceae), locally known as *kaunigai*, and *Myristica* species (Myristicaceae), locally known as *kaudamu*. The largest tree is a *Parinari insularum* (Chrysobalanaceae), locally known as *sa*, and the tallest is an *Agathis macrophylla* (Araucariaceae), locally known as *dakua makadre*.
